senses.sense_definition: An imprecise solution or result that is adequate for a specific purpose.

examples.text: The engineer provided a rough <w>approximation</w> of the total cost for the building project.
This calculation is just an <w>approximation</w> but it is close enough for our current needs.

senses.sense_definition: A thing that is similar to something else but not exactly the same.

examples.text: The cheap watch was merely an <w>approximation</w> of the luxury brand he really wanted.
Her painting was a poor <w>approximation</w> of the beautiful landscape she saw on her trip.

senses.sense_definition: The act of producing a near-simulation of the pronunciation of a foreign language for a loanword.

examples.text: English speakers often use an <w>approximation</w> when pronouncing words borrowed from other languages.
The pronunciation of the word is an <w>approximation</w> of the original French term.

senses.sense_definition: The act of bringing together the edges of tissue to be sutured.

examples.text: Proper <w>approximation</w> of the wound edges is essential for effective healing after surgery.
The surgeon ensured careful <w>approximation</w> of the skin before applying the final stitches.
